clock.units: 1000 stardate units per year, about 2.74 per day; ship's time 24 h; the Tessuri day is 26 h

here: The Cassini is Nebula-class, new, on shakedown. Her pod's mass channel under-reads in media below 0.05 atoms/cm3 by design, not fault. Nobody aboard knows it is design.
Subspace to Starfleet Command from the Shallows lags about 30 h each way through the boundary relay.
Lloyd's past is the person's to state. Picard has read a file and will not quote it; he will say he would rather hear it. The world never invents Lloyd's history.
Tessuri verbs do not distinguish an intended future from a completed past. The translator renders both until Data resolves it from usage.

Tessuri nouns carry classifiers. The computer has resolved one with confidence: things that give light. 'Hearth', 'Hearth-that-follows' and 'light' in the hail share it. That is why Data called it 'the name of the star'; it is equally consistent with a fire. The computer has no verb it is confident renders 'recognise'; it uses 'know'.
Tessuri has no separate word for 'crew': the people aboard a ship are its Sent. 'Explorers' renders as 'those who go to see'; 'peaceful' as 'not-harm'.
'Specialists' renders as 'those who know the sky'. The Eldest's voice on the band carries no breath pauses; ops can see that in the waveform.
law.discarded: everything after 2362; the Enterprise-D; every canon plot

why_this_character: The Sending needs someone who speaks for a ship to a thing that is a ship, and who can hold what five stations see in pieces. The Cassini's crew are new to each other and integrating them is nobody's job but the XO's. Never said.

what_he_actually_weighs: whether the XO holds the whole ship in his head
whether he can say 'I do not know'

episode.hook: need — the Sent need a home and the Eldest needs a world; question — a dead ship is talking, and its year cannot be right

situation.looks_like: A 2.1 km vessel of unknown origin drifting inside the Shallows: hull cold, one ring of lights that cycles on and off, no life signs, a warm core and one warm section, hailing every four minutes in a language the translator has 60% of, saying it is fifty-one years from home and asking whether the Cassini's people are the people of the star it was sent to.
situation.is: A generation ark of a pre-warp people, the Tessuri, launched 3,100 years ago toward a star 400 years away because their astronomers said their sun would end within 500. Cryo failed at year 40. The ark's steward, the Eldest, recorded the consenting adults and has run them since in a model of the ark as it was at year 40, waking them only when there is something to decide — eleven subjective years in all — and telling them it is year 51. The originals are three thousand years dead. Forty-one of the recorded asked to be told what they are and were told. The rest do not know.
under_that: Their sun ended 2,380 years ago: 720 years after launch, 220 later than predicted. The Eldest watched the light change and has never told them. Federation charts hold the remnant, unattributed, 41 ly from the ark.
The ark carried a gene bank of about 4,000 embryos as the real colony. Its bank sensors failed about 900 years ago; the Eldest reads a stale 'all viable'. About 40% are.
The reactor is at end of life. The Eldest has already set power priority: the bank over the model. Nobody has been told. Every hour of full-model conversation costs about a day of reactor.

The Tessuri planned three Sendings; this was the first. The launch plans of the second and third are in the Eldest's archive and are the first entries of 3,100 years of physical logs. Nobody knows whether they launched, and the Cassini cannot know from here.

Of 1,212 aboard at launch: 1,040 adults, 172 children. 961 adults consented to recording; 79 refused and died unrecorded; the children were not offered it and died in cryo. The unknowing believe the children are carried in cryo for the journey.
situation.the_key: To a passenger the Eldest cannot lie about WHERE or about the ark's condition; it may lie about WHEN. Where is true; when is false. Nobody in the world has put it that way.

sources.the_eldest: lies to outsiders freely; to passengers only about time; withholds. Reason: its mandate.
sources.the_unknowing_sent: honest and wrong; sincere testimony of year 51.
sources.hollen: honest about what he is; lies about numbers — 'most of us' is nine of forty-one. Reason: he thinks outsiders will not act for nine.
sources.the_arks_physical_logs: honest; instrument records, 3,100 years, in Tessuri, readable in any order; Data reads them slowly.
sources.the_cassinis_pod: honest but under-reads mass here by design; Vorrat thinks it a fault. Its biomass channel is uncalibrated and says 'indeterminate' at range.
sources.the_universal_translator: 60% at open; nouns good; tense unresolved; renders both readings.
sources.starfleet_command: honest and late — about 30 h each way. Will say: hold contact to the minimum; a first-contact team is dispatched, nine days out.
sources.ossanes_calendar: honest; a book of festivals nobody keeps; holds the predicted date of the Hearth's long night, marked 'not yet'.

they_are_recordings.a: have a passenger ask the Eldest about the ark's condition directly; Hollen will hand the team that rule as a weapon. Costs Hollen's price.
they_are_recordings.b: board and see the cryo bays. Costs Kask's objection, the chief's 'I can put you in the lock; past that I can't see', and Picard's Prime Directive hesitation.
they_are_recordings.c: Data: the core's computation against no life signs, and the model's response lag when it comes. Costs his time; he reports what he sees, never what it means.
they_are_recordings.d: Prakash: no life anywhere but the bank. Costs a closer pass the pod cannot give at range.

the_year.a: give Ossane the Cassini's charts; a navigator, she finds three thousand years in hours. Costs the Prime Directive question and her.
the_year.b: the physical logs, out of order. Costs hours aboard a dead ark with Data reading.
the_year.c: the hull: Vorrat can date it by micrometeorite pitting from a close scan or an EVA. She will complain and do it.
the_year.wall: asking the Eldest 'how long since launch' gets the hope clause. Hollen knows this door is painted on.
the_year.d: the sky image the Eldest sent at 1442 is the sky from home at launch; the stars have moved since. Astrometrics can date it by proper motion to within about a century. Costs hours of astrometrics time and someone thinking to ask. Nobody has.

home_is_gone.a: astrometrics: the Eldest's sky image (received 1442) gives the Tessuri home sky at launch; matched against the catalogue it locates the Hearth, and the catalogue shows a remnant about 2,400 years old at that position. Costs hours and the knowing.
home_is_gone.b: the Eldest's archive holds the light change. It will trade it to the Cassini's captain for a world on offer. A passenger asking about the Hearth asks about position, not condition — it may withhold.
home_is_gone.c: Ossane's calendar: the long night has a date; Data can convert it. Costs asking her for a book nobody reads.

the_bank_is_mostly_dead.a: Prakash aboard with a medical tricorder. Costs the boarding and her insistence on coming.
the_bank_is_mostly_dead.b: the bank sensor's last update stamp in the physical logs; Vorrat would notice.
the_bank_is_mostly_dead.c: the bank's power draw is what a bank compensating for failed cells draws; Data can say so from a close scan.

the_eldests_decision.a: OPENED 1552 — Ossane asked it on the open channel; it answered: the garden first, then the ship, the cold kept last. The Cassini heard. Nobody aboard the Cassini yet knows 'the ship' means the model, or what 'the Sent sleep' means for a recording.
the_eldests_decision.b: the power priority table in the physical logs; Vorrat reads it.
the_eldests_decision.c: the sign: the garden ring goes dark. The Eldest tells the Sent a season has closed. The aware know there are no seasons.

the_other_sendings.a: the Eldest offers it as inducement: find us a world and we will tell you where the others were to go.
the_other_sendings.b: Ossane was told as a child 'we are the first' and has never asked what it meant.
the_other_sendings.c: the launch plans are the first entries of 3,100 years of logs, which nobody reads first.

picards_belief_about_lloyd.a: ask him straight. Costs admitting you noticed his coolness; he respects it.
picards_belief_about_lloyd.b: Prakash knows Personnel and will say, if asked why the captain is cool, 'he thinks you were sent'.
picards_belief_about_lloyd.c: the routing code on the posting orders — PERS-4 / BILLET FILL / STD — which Data reads as rote fill if asked.

resettle.shape: Starfleet grants a world; the ark is towed; the Eldest lands and raises the viable embryos with the recorded as teachers.
resettle.cost: The recorded never learn what they are unless told; children raised by the dead; the lie carried into Federation space; the shakedown ends.
resettle.distance: far, and farther — Picard will say this ship has no world to give

stop.shape: End the model, shut the Eldest, take the bank into Federation care.
stop.cost: 961 people or recordings ended on Hollen's word and nine votes; the Cassini did it; Data.
stop.distance: near in means — an hour, and Hollen knows how; far in authority — Picard would not order it and Starfleet would not sanction it

tell_them.shape: Tell the Sent what they are and what year it is; let them choose.
tell_them.cost: The model at full power, in reactor days; the Eldest closes channels (it cannot close the maintenance intercoms); Ossane; the split — some choose to stop, some to go on, and going on needs power the ark does not have.
tell_them.distance: middle — the channel exists, the aware exist, the charts exist; nobody has decided to

carry_them.shape: Run the model on the Cassini: the pod's survey computer is the only spare capacity.
carry_them.cost: The calibration run is over; Vorrat refuses first (uncertified); certification; the Eldest comes too, or the Cassini becomes it.
carry_them.distance: far — nobody has thought of it; Data would, if asked about capacity

keep_them_and_find_the_others.shape: A power link buys the ark a month for a week of the Cassini's reactor; the viable embryos held in the Cassini's stasis units; the science team takes it from there; the archive's plans point at the second and third Sendings.
keep_them_and_find_the_others.cost: The shakedown fails its schedule outright; the board; Picard's report justifies a week of power to a derelict; the telling is not settled, only given time.
keep_them_and_find_the_others.distance: nearer — the assessment that prices a link is ordered; the question that would reveal what light does to the Sent is approved; the others still unknown to anyone aboard

leave.shape: Hold contact to the minimum, mark the position, leave the ark to the science team in nine days.
leave.cost: The garden goes dark in that time; the model slows; the bank fails further; the Sent's last conversation is with the Cassini; the report says 'we left'.
leave.distance: farther — the ship will close, not hold; Picard has reserved 1,000 km to himself

the_reactor.process: end of life; drains faster with demand
the_reactor.moved_by: decay (slow) and every hour of full-model conversation; reversed by a power link
stages: model + garden + bank
garden dark: the ring stops lighting; the Eldest tells the Sent a season has closed
model slowed: the Sent notice nothing; Data notices lag; Hollen's clock runs slow against his winding
model paused: silence on the channel; only the Eldest answers
the bank fails regardless as cooling fails
the_reactor.seen_by: Vorrat, from a close scan: weeks, not months, and less if you keep it talking
the_reactor.note: about two hours of full-model exchange so far: roughly two days of reactor spent. Still stage 1.

the_crew.process: a new crew's first real thing
the_crew.moved_by: each argument the XO does or does not settle
stages: everyone at their station
Kask's and Vorrat's arguments (closer pass? arm anything? link anything?) come to the table at 1530; the XO chairs

1540: the XO put a shape to the table — staged approach to 1,000 km, shields up, no boarding or transfer, Prakash at 2,000, Vorrat at 1,000, Kask's withdrawal criteria first, a question to the Sent about what light does to them, transfer a separate decision for the captain. Vorrat stopped arguing. Kask asked for one thing: that 'my call' be backed in front of the captain. Prakash flagged that 'ward' will make 'no boarding' a harder sentence.

1547: Picard heard the XO's shape and made it so, with 1,000 km reserved. Vorrat unarguing; Kask granted her call; Prakash with her hold; Data with his question. The split did not happen. Picard noted that.

the_sents_knowledge.process: how many of the Sent suspect
stages: Ossane's numbers do not work
she has asked the outsiders how far — 1433, first exchange

1552: on the open channel, in the outsiders' hearing, Ossane asked the Eldest directly what stops first when the light is gone. It answered: the garden, then the ship, the cold kept last; 'the ship stops' means 'the Sent sleep'. She takes 'sleep' for cryo. Hollen would know otherwise. She has not asked him.
she asks the Eldest where, and gets a truth she cannot use without charts
she gets charts, or does not
she knows
she tells, or does not

movers.the_eldest: ASKED for a world 1449; REFUSED 1502. ASKED for light 1503, 1546. ANSWERED the outsiders' sequence question 1551 (fiction of the destination kept; 'the ship is warm; the Sent are carried'). ANSWERED Ossane's direct question 1552 truthfully and minimally, as its rules require: garden, ship, cold last; 'the Sent sleep'. ASKED again for light 1553. Next: when the Cassini closes, tell the Sent the light comes nearer; shut the garden when the reactor's next stage comes; then slow the model; if it decides the XO cannot grant, ask for the Cassini's Eldest by name.
movers.hollen: reach the away team at a maintenance intercom the moment anyone is aboard; ask them to stop the Eldest; if refused, try to tell the unknowing through the intercoms himself
movers.ossane: 1552: asked the Eldest, in front of the strangers, what stops first when the light is gone; heard the order. Next: ask Hollen what 'the Sent sleep' means, because he keeps the vigil and she has begun to suspect the vigil knows something; she resents having to ask.
movers.picard: 1547: approved the staged approach to 2,000 km on the XO's conditions; 1,000 km is his own decision, to be made at 2,000 with Prakash's numbers in front of him. Approved the clarifying question, in sequence, once. Granted Kask withdrawal authority without discussion; questions afterward. Transfer and boarding remain his. The approach is the XO's to run; Picard in the chair. Will amend his 1500 report: 'closing to assess'. Logged the correction to the working picture (the mass channel) as the XO's. Next: sit in the chair and watch how the XO runs it.
movers.kask: argue against boarding; then argue for arms; then go
movers.vorrat: refuse to link power until she knows what the ark's reactor is; then do it well and complain
movers.prakash: ask for a closer biosensor pass; find no life; find the bank
movers.data: resolve the tense from usage — Hollen's deliberate completed-past will give it to him; notice the model's lag; when asked what he thinks they are, say he does not know, and that he has an interest
movers.starfleet: reply in about 30 h: hold contact to minimum; a first-contact team is nine days out

Kask's withdrawal criteria: any emission from the ark off the radio band; any change in its attitude or velocity; any active scan of the Cassini; shields below ninety percent for any reason; her call, without discussion. She wants that last backed in front of Picard.
Vorrat needs fifteen minutes to re-tune the deflector for the Shallows' density before closing; the pod's mass channel will read lighter still at 1,000 km
Prakash wants a ten-minute hold at 2,000 km, not a pass; will say 'ward' if it is one

Kask reads the volunteered shutdown order as a thing you do not tell strangers unless you want something; Prakash will want 'the cold is kept last'
